background: NatWest Group is the holding company of the UK's largest business bank, owner of NatWest, Royal Bank of Scotland, Ulster Bank and Coutts, returned to full private ownership after its financial-crisis rescue.
synthesis: The group is rated A on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A-, all on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 10 Sep 2025. Capital is on the weak side of UK majors, with CET1 of 13.2% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 4.7% below the peer median. Liquidity is mixed, with LCR of 140% below the median and down 10 points since 30 Jun 2025, and NSFR of 132% just above it. The newest flagged item, on 18 Sep 2026, is half-year results with return on tangible equity up to 19.7% and upgraded guidance.
